title: Banking Associates
age_limit: Minimum: 20 years, Maximum: 30 years (Born between 01-01-1996 and 01-01-2006)
summary: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. has invited online applications from domiciles of UT of J&K for the recruitment of 1033 Banking Associates. Eligible candidates can register online through the bank's website under the careers tab between November 7, 2026, and November 26, 2026. Selection will be based on an online examination conducted by IBPS.
eligibility_bullets: Must be a domicile of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir.
Must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university as on the last date of registration.
Age must be between 20 and 30 years as of 01-01-2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories and eligible apprentices.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Reservation rules of UT of J&K applicable

how_to_apply_steps: Check eligibility criteria from the official notification.
Visit the Bank's official website at https://jkb.bank.in/ and navigate to the 'Careers' tab.
Complete the online registration process and submit all required details accurately.
Pay the application fee through the online payment mode to complete the registration.
